title: Week 26: Adb over Wifi
content:
Week 26: Adb over Wifi

Customize a Media Pipe Model

These weeks I was working on using media pipe. I only used those pre-trained models. However, some of the models, like image classification and gesture recognizer can be fine tuned.

Sadly the pose landmark detection is not provided with customize function. Anyway, Gemini is now integrated with media pipe, meaning the framework will soon get more functions.

SpaceDesk over USB

Direct USB Cable Connection (Android only) is in the console.

ADB debug WearOS

Using adb on wifi is the only way to debug wearOS. Android Studio supplies a GUI to connect Android devices over wifi, however, my watch is Galaxy Watch, I can not make it work. Samsung Dev provides the terminal way. Keep in mind that adb over wifi is very slow, and it doesn't show the progress when installing an apk.
